    The Piper Center for Vocation and Career helps students explore careers, gain experience outside of the classroom, and pursue meaningful post-graduate work, service, and education.

    Jobs? Internships? Opportunities?

    Oles can. Oles will.

    83%

    Percentage of Oles who attended a Piper Center event or met with a Career Coach or Peer Advisor last year

    91%

    Percentage of Oles who participated in an internship, mentored research experience, field experience, practicum, academic civic engagement, long-term shadowing, or similar experiential learning opportunity during their time at St. Olaf (91% knowledge rate)

    88%

    Percentage of graduates from the Class of 2024 who agreed or strongly agreed that they felt confident in their ability to pursue meaningful post-graduate activities (93% knowledge rate)

    95%

    Percentage of graduates from the Class of 2025 who were working, participating in a full-time service program, or pursuing further education within nine months of graduation. (91% knowledge rate)
